peers.name: NIPPON L I A M LTD

bull_bear.body:
- "Net Cash^ available as on 30th June 2026: Rs 312 Cr vs. Rs 234 Cr as on 30th June 2025". The deck's own definition: "Net cash available is the sum of cash & cash equivalents, bank balances other than cash, investments, trade receivables, current tax assets (net), other financial assets, lease deposits subtracted with provisions, other payables, other non-financial liabilities and borrowings".
- Balance-sheet philosophy is stated as "Debt-free structure with high operational efficiency and low capital risk" and "Minimal capital requirements ensuring high ROE"; the deck flags its ROE as "*Not adjusted for cash".
- Growth is presented on a multi-year compounding basis: "40.8% Revenue CAGR (FY23 - FY26)" and "103.4% PAT CAGR (FY23 - FY26)".
- The deck contains no dividend, buyback, ESOP or capital-raising policy for DAM Capital itself.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- Self-described as "One of India's Fastest-growing Merchant Bank", footnoted as "(1) In terms of Revenue as per CRISIL"; the business is presented as two segments, Merchant Banking and Institutional Equities, under a "Capital Markets" banner with the tagline "With DAM Capital, It's Possible!".
- Execution track record: "98 ECM transactions executed from Nov' 2019 to Jun' 2026 raising Rs 1,62,700+ Cr", comprising "41 IPOs (3), 22 QIPs, 8 Preferential issues, 8 OFS" where footnote (3) reads "includes 1 REIT"; Nov-2019 is dated in the deck as "11-Nov-2019 was the date of Acquisition of IDFC Securities".
- Distribution breadth on the equities side: "304" Active Clients "Across India, US, UK, Europe, Hong Kong, Singapore", served by a "32 Member Broking Team (with average work experience of 23+ years)".
- Deal footprint is spread across industries rather than concentrated: the ECM table lists Financial Services 17 transactions / Rs 26,221 Cr, Capital Goods 13 / Rs 13,263 Cr, Pharma & Healthcare 11 / Rs 8,116 Cr, Construction and Construction Materials 8 / Rs 15,083 Cr, and Others 14 / Rs 64,366 Cr.
- Board is presented as a "Distinguished and highly experienced Independent Board" (Chairperson Mr. MV Nair, ex-Chairman and MD of Union Bank of India and Dena Bank), with MD & CEO Mr. Dharmesh Anil Mehta, "a capital market veteran with over 30 years of experience", formerly MD-Equities at ENAM Securities and later MD and CEO of Axis Capital.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Origin] The franchise is dated from an acquisition, not a founding: "*11-Nov-2019 was the date of Acquisition of IDFC Securities", and every cumulative statistic (98 ECM transactions, Rs 1,62,700+ Cr) is measured "since acquisition".
- [Shareholding, 30 Jun 2026, source BSE] Promoter & Promoter Group 40.00%; Resident Individuals* 40.65%; Bodies Corporate 5.99%; Alternate Investment Funds 5.15%; Others 2.80%; Insurance Companies 1.75%; NRIs 1.11%; Foreign Portfolio Investors (Cat I + II) 0.99%; Mutual Funds 0.96%; Foreign Companies 0.60%. Institutional ownership is therefore very thin relative to a 40% promoter block.
- [Regulatory] The entity carries three distinct SEBI registrations - Stock Broking (BSE Capital Markets / NSE Capital Markets / NSE Futures & Options) INZ000207137, Research Analyst INH000000131 and Merchant Banker MB/INM000011336.
- [Industry backdrop, source Prime Database] Mainboard IPO+QIP issuance is shown as 140 (FY24), 163 (FY25), 141 (FY26), 22 (Q1 FY27) issues; and as on 30th June 2026 there were 224 companies with "IPOs / FPOs filed with SEBI" for "Rs 2,90,000+ Cr (for 126* disclosed issue amounts)", with the footnote "*224 Mainboard IPO filings include 98 filings with undisclosed issue amounts". Within that, "18 DRHPs filed by DAM Capital including 12 approved by SEBI".
- [Industry backdrop, source NSE/BSE/AMFI/SEBI] Institutional AUM pools grew from 31-Mar-23 to 30-Jun-26: Mutual Fund 5.3 to 9.3 Rs Lakh Cr (1.8x), PMS* 3.4 to 6.8 (2.0x), AIF^ 39.4 to 82.2 (2.1x); equity cash segment turnover shows "3Y CAGR (FY23-26): 25.1%" and the equity derivative segment "3Y CAGR (FY23-26): 42.0%".
